confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of East Java and Indonesian pricing; no live listings or menus were checked. Restaurant and dorm anchors are the more reliable ones. Hotel anchors are less certain because Banyuwangi has fewer registered properties and wider rate variation, especially near ferry and national park areas. Cocktail and wine_glass are derived from the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.5x beer, wine glass about 3x beer) because direct knowledge of local bar pricing is weak. Wine is scarce and import-taxed in Indonesia, so the wine anchor is the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: smaller East Java and Indonesian provincial tourist towns, priced below Bali's resort hubs (Ubud, Seminyak) and broadly comparable to budget-to-mid tiers in Malang and Yogyakarta. Used as a relative reference only, not a sourced price list.
